claim_grade: bounded public-evidence routing audit; no physical sufficiency or new-physics verdict

gate.trial_table: trial/order, preparation, instrument outcome, output setting and result, validity/rejection, calibration block
gate.calibration_table: preparation model, readout confusion, joint uncertainty, controller/decoder version
gate.process_schema: selective-map convention, normalization, physicality projection, raw-row-to-map rule
gate.multitime_table: repeat index, reset or causal break, held-out continuation

ingestion_rule: all four fields must be PASS

candidates.title: Learning and forecasting open quantum dynamics with correlated noise
source_observations: The paper identifies the GitHub repository as its experimental-data and code packet.
Repository README blob 08acfaae30ca332a60f5b6fdc1b1cb1262482546 says experiment_data contains raw data and reconstructed process tensors.
split_rb_data.jl blob 63875ce93997ce23fc7dc334e8754df2d994c5c3 reduces each public row to cl_ops plus aggregate p0, then creates train/test splits.
two_qubit_model_rb_unitary.jl blob dd40e6b7e1ac4e1291578684afaa85de5f523f5a consumes those train/test pairs and fits an OQE model.
candidates.trial_reason: Public sequence identity and aggregate p0 exist, but the inspected schema does not expose per-shot outcomes, rejection reasons, or calibration-block linkage.
candidates.calibration_reason: No preparation/readout confusion model, joint uncertainty object, or controller-version join was located in the inspected packet.
candidates.process_reason: Code and reconstructed OQE/process-tensor objects exist, but the raw-row-to-complete-selective-map convention required by the DU gate is not present in the inspected schema.
candidates.multitime_reason: Long gate sequences and held-out/future prediction exist; explicit repeat, reset, and causal-break rows are not exposed by the inspected schema.

candidates.title: Demonstration of non-Markovian process characterisation and control on a quantum processor
source_observations: The paper reconstructs four-time restricted process tensors on IBM Quantum devices.
The paper states that available operations span only a unitary-control subspace, not a complete CP-map basis.
Its Data availability and Code availability statements say materials are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
candidates.trial_reason: No public row-level data packet; author request is external.
candidates.process_reason: The published process is explicitly restricted to the span of available unitary controls rather than a complete selective instrument.
candidates.multitime_reason: Four-time experiments and out-of-basis predictions are reported, but no public reset/causal-break row table is available.

candidates.title: Non-Markovian Quantum Process Tomography
source_observations: The paper supplies full process-tensor-tomography requirements, maximum-likelihood reconstruction, and positive causal projection.
It reports IBM Quantum validation and multi-time predictive control.
The bounded public screen did not locate a linked row-level experimental and calibration packet.
candidates.trial_reason: No public row-level packet was located in the bounded screen.
candidates.calibration_reason: No calibration join was located in the bounded screen.
candidates.process_reason: The publication gives the needed complete process-tensor schema and physicality constraints at method level.
candidates.multitime_reason: Multi-time reconstruction and validation are reported, but a public repeat/reset/held-out row table was not located.

candidates.title: Experimental single-qubit quantum process instrument
source_observations: The published platform implements a real trapped-ion quantum instrument.
The linked Zenodo record is figure-source data rather than a trial-, calibration-, controller-, provenance-, and multitime-resolved packet.
candidates.trial_reason: Figure-source summaries are not trial rows.
candidates.calibration_reason: The public packet lacks the required calibration join.
candidates.process_reason: The publication identifies an instrument, but the linked packet does not expose complete selective maps with uncertainty and a row-to-map convention.
candidates.multitime_reason: The linked packet is not an ordered multitime assay.

next_action: Do not run a sufficiency verdict. Audit whether Xiang et al. have a public shot/calibration sidecar outside the inspected schema; otherwise design or locate a new four-table experiment.
limits: The screen is bounded and does not prove that unlocated files do not exist.
Repository file schemas were inspected, but the large raw JSON was not reinterpreted beyond its public preprocessing code.
No author was contacted and no external action was taken.
A screen score is evidence readiness, not scientific merit.
